title: Lump Sum Funding in Horizon Europe: How does it work? How to write a proposal?
summary: A two-hour Commission webinar explaining how lump sum grants work in Horizon Europe and what that means when writing a proposal.
details: Part of the Commission's autumn series of webinars on Horizon Europe applications and project implementation, it is aimed at applicants and beneficiaries of lump sum grants. It runs from 10:00 to 12:00 CET and no registration is required.
why: Lump sums change how the budget and work plan must be built, and errors there are hard to fix after submission. Teams preparing 2027 proposals under a lump sum topic should attend before finalising their budget.
